name: search_clinical_trials
description: Search for clinical trials related to a specific disease or condition. Use this tool when you need to find ongoing or completed clinical trials for a particular disease. Do NOT use this tool for non-clinical research studies or for general medical information; for broader medical literature, consider using 'search_pubmed'.

parameters.name: disease_name
parameters.description: The name of the disease or condition to search for clinical trials. Should be a complete name or commonly used abbreviation (e.g. 'diabetes', 'breast cancer'). Must not exceed 100 characters.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: The phase of clinical trials to filter results. Must be one of: 'Phase 1', 'Phase 2', 'Phase 3', 'Phase 4', or 'All'. Defaults to 'All' if not specified.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Geographical location to filter clinical trials (e.g. 'United States', 'Europe'). Must not exceed 100 characters. Omit to include trials from all locations.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of clinical trials to return, ranked by relevance. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

trials.description: List of clinical trials matching the search criteria. Each item includes: trial_id (string), title (string), phase (string), location (string), status (string), and start_date (ISO 8601 date).

total_count.description: Total number of clinical trials found matching the criteria, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing 'trials' (list of matching clinical trials) and 'total_count' (total matches before truncation).
